name: launchblocks-hts-burn-commands
description: Every quality gate CI runs for the core and the app, plus a credential-free dry run that proves the new flow's wiring type-checks. Nothing here needs secrets or the network beyond installing packages.

commands.name: core-test
commands.purpose: Core unit tests, including the step contract test every registered step must pass.

commands.name: core-types
commands.purpose: Strict type check of the core package.

commands.name: docs-check
commands.purpose: The README step table matches the registry.

commands.name: burn-flow-dry-run
commands.purpose: The new gallery flow validates end to end, references and all, without touching the network.

commands.name: build
commands.purpose: Production build of the app, including its type check.
